title: Multi-Region Disaster Recovery Architecture
scenario: A financial services company requires a multi-Region active-passive disaster recovery architecture for their trading platform. The primary Region handles all traffic, with automatic failover to the secondary Region if the primary becomes unavailable. The RTO is 5 minutes and RPO is 1 minute. Design the networking layer including DNS failover, cross-Region connectivity, and data replication paths.
requirements: Primary and secondary VPCs in different AWS Regions with non-overlapping CIDRs
Route 53 health checks with automatic DNS failover
Cross-Region VPC connectivity for data replication
Application Load Balancers in both Regions
Private subnets for databases with cross-Region replication path
Security groups and NACLs following least-privilege principles
